title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: admins manage federated Copilot connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center
notes: claim 65: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: Microsoft documents preview automation for publisher-type access and User access, which the briefing incorrectly reports as undocumented. The arrival default needs narrower wording, and the risk rationale overstates approval by implying that every write action requires confirmation.

claims.claim: Admins can govern and manage federated Copilot connectors in the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Admins can govern and manage federated copilot connectors in Microsoft 365 admin center. #copilotcontrolsystem

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters
claims.claim: The administration change is on by default, so licensed users can connect Microsoft-built connectors unless an admin changed settings.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Agent and plugin access default Microsoft selected', 'federated connectors default enabled'; read overview, manage and agent-settings. Current text gives conditional connector availability and All users, not an arrival default for this control change.
claims.fix: Set defaultState to unknown. Replace 'Expect licensed users to be able to connect Microsoft-built connectors unless an admin has changed these settings.' with 'Microsoft has not stated the arrival default for this administration change. Check the tenant settings: Microsoft-built connector availability depends on Agent and plugin access and User access.' Retain the separately documented All users default and conditional connector-availability sentence.
